text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
You want to hear... ghost stories? I
suppose there
are a few German castles
that are said to be
haunted.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps the most famous ones are the
tale of the
female knight who still
protects her castle, or the
pale woman
who wanders the halls of her abode...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wooow! So if I went to one of those
castles, I bet
I could get a selfie with the
ghosts. ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wh-why would you do that?! Aren't you
scared of
ghosts?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm, well, a ghost should still be able
to see
how cute I am, so... Nope! I think
I'll be safe. ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The power of cuteness... Ah, now that
you
mention it...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it super common for idols to be sent
to
haunted locations for shoots? What
am I gonna
dooo?!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, ghosts are not real. We
need not
fear ghosts that have no
corporeal form...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
But zombies... Zombies are a different
story. Far
worse than any ghost.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Both of them sound scary to meee!
